project.description: Backend Full Build - Builds all microservices

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
echo "==========================================" echo "Backend Build Started" echo "Time: $(date)" echo "=========================================="
cd /var/jenkins_home/workspace/project-management/backend
echo "[1/5] Cleaning previous builds..." mvn clean -q
echo "[2/5] Validating POM files..." mvn validate
echo "[3/5] Compiling all modules..." mvn compile -DskipTests
echo "[4/5] Running tests..." mvn test || true
echo "[5/5] Packaging all modules..." mvn package -DskipTests
echo "==========================================" echo "Build Complete!" echo "Time: $(date)" echo "=========================================="
echo "Generated JAR files:" find . -name "*.jar" -path "*/target/*" ! -name "*-sources.jar" -exec ls -lh {} \;
